name: Distributor Report
query:
SELECT
    d.attendee_name                      AS `attendee_name`,
    d.designation                        AS `designation`,
    d.distributor_name                   AS `distributor_name`,
    d.distributor_contact_number         AS `distributor_contact_number`,
    d.distributor_email_address          AS `distributor_email_address`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(mdc.distributor_code, ''), d.account__distributor_code) AS `distributor_code`,
    d.distributor_company_address        AS `distributor_company_address`,
    d.country                            AS `country`,
    d.city                               AS `city`,
    d.state                              AS `state`,
    d.region                             AS `region`,
    d.distributor_company_name           AS `distributor_company_name`,
    IFNULL(CAST(d.login_reminder_count AS CHAR), '0') AS `login_remainer_count`,
    IFNULL(CAST(le.course_reminder_count AS CHAR), '0') AS `course_reminder_count`,

    -- Document status per enrollment (no join explosion)
    (
        SELECT CASE
                 WHEN dcd.has_submitted_documents = 1 THEN 'Yes'
                 WHEN dcd.has_submitted_documents = 0 THEN 'No'
                 ELSE 'Not Submitted'
               END
        FROM `tabDistributor Course Documents` dcd
        WHERE dcd.distributor = d.name
          AND dcd.course = le.course
        ORDER BY (dcd.enrollment_version = le.enrollment_version) DESC,
                 dcd.is_current_enrollment DESC,
                 dcd.modified DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS `has_submitted_documents`,
    (
        SELECT dcd.submission_datetime
        FROM `tabDistributor Course Documents` dcd
        WHERE dcd.distributor = d.name
          AND dcd.course = le.course
        ORDER BY (dcd.enrollment_version = le.enrollment_version) DESC,
                 dcd.is_current_enrollment DESC,
                 dcd.modified DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS `submission_datetime`,

    le.course                            AS `course`,
    CAST(ROUND(le.progress, 2) AS CHAR)  AS `progress`,
    le.completed_on                      AS `completed_on`,
    le.completion_status                 AS `completion_status`,
    le.enrollment_version                AS `enrollment_version`,

    -- One row per child division × enrollment
    mdc.division                         AS `division`,
    mdc.meril_company_name               AS `meril_company_name`,
    mdc.rsm                              AS `rsm`,
    mdc.bu_head                          AS `bu_head`

FROM `tabDistributor` AS d
LEFT JOIN `tabLMS Enrollment` AS le
    ON le.member = d.user_id
LEFT JOIN `tabMeril Distributor Division Child` AS mdc
    ON d.name = mdc.parent
ORDER BY d.distributor_name, mdc.division, le.enrollment_version;
